title: The Art Basel and UBS Art Market Report 2026
notes: Evidence extracted from uploaded Art Basel and UBS Art Market Report 2026 text.

MarketUncertainty.rationale: Report repeatedly cites geopolitical volatility, tariffs, policy unpredictability, rising costs, and uneven recovery as market pressures.

CollectorFlightToSafety.rationale: Report says lingering risk aversion concentrated higher prices in established and older market sectors rather than newer artists.

BlueChipConcentration.rationale: High-end sales above $10 million drove recovery, while established artists and older sectors outperformed newer Contemporary sectors.

AuctionSpeculationElevated.rationale: Public auction sales rose 9%, with stronger activity above $10 million and record-setting high-end auction results.

MarketPolarization.rationale: Growth was uneven across price tiers, regions, dealers, and sectors, with high-end recovery alongside pressure elsewhere.

BiennialFatigue.rationale: Dealers described art fairs as expensive, repetitive, lifestyle-driven, and producing diminishing returns, though still important.

PrestigeFragmentation.rationale: Report notes shifts toward local sales, newer gallery models, artist-direct sales, online channels, and regional variation.

RegionalSceneMomentum.rationale: France, Switzerland, South Korea, Spain, Brazil, and some other regions showed growth despite mixed global performance.

AuthenticityPremium.rationale: Report notes AI-generated works may have lower commercial value and resale rights than works tied to human intellectual creation.

RitualAuraPremium.rationale: Report says live auctions, exhibitions, fairs, and in-person events remain essential for attracting buyers and generating sales.

causal_claims.rationale: Report states that lingering risk aversion concentrated higher prices in established and older market sectors rather than newer artists, directly linking uncertainty to collector retreat to safety.
causal_claims.evidence_span: lingering risk aversion concentrated higher prices in established and older market sectors
